Question: Academic lineage: Trace the complete supervision chain for every doctoral researcher (e.g. who is the 'academic grandparent' of Sofia Lindqvist and Tomas Berg?).
Cypher Query:
MATCH p = (root:Person)-[:SUPERVISED*1..]->(s:Person)
WHERE NOT EXISTS { (:Person)-[:SUPERVISED {kind:'doctoral'}]->(root) }
  AND ALL(r IN relationships(p) WHERE r.kind = 'doctoral')
WITH s, nodes(p) AS chain
RETURN s.name AS doctoral_researcher,
       [n IN chain | n.name] AS supervision_chain_oldest_to_researcher,
       chain[-2].name AS supervisor,
       CASE WHEN size(chain) >= 3 THEN chain[-3].name ELSE null END AS academic_grandparent,
       size(chain) - 1 AS generations_from_root
ORDER BY doctoral_researcher
Answer: [{"doctoral_researcher": "Arjun Menon", "supervision_chain_oldest_to_researcher": ["Priya Raghunathan", "Arjun Menon"], "supervisor": "Priya Raghunathan", "academic_grandparent": null, "generations_from_root": 1}, {"doctoral_researcher": "Hannah Brooks", "supervision_chain_oldest_to_researcher": ["Daniel Okafor", "Hannah Brooks"], "supervisor": "Daniel Okafor", "academic_grandparent": null, "generations_from_root": 1}, {"doctoral_researcher": "Ingrid Solberg", "supervision_chain_oldest_to_researcher": ["Markus Weber", "Ingrid Solberg"], "supervisor": "Markus Weber", "academic_grandparent": null, "generations_from_root": 1}, {"doctoral_researcher": "Sofia Lindqvist", "supervision_chain_oldest_to_researcher": ["Markus Weber", "Ingrid Solberg", "Sofia Lindqvist"], "supervisor": "Ingrid Solberg", "academic_grandparent": "Markus Weber", "generations_from_root": 2}, {"doctoral_researcher": "Tomas Berg", "supervision_chain_oldest_to_researcher": ["Markus Weber", "Ingrid Solberg", "Tomas Berg"], "supervisor": "Ingrid Solberg", "academic_grandparent": "Markus Weber", "generations_from_root": 2}]

Question: Mobility: Which researchers have been affiliated with more than one organization (employment or study), and what was the direction of each move?
Cypher Query:
MATCH (p:Person)-[a:AFFILIATED_WITH]->(o:Organization)
WITH p, a, o ORDER BY a.seq
WITH p, collect({org: o.name, kind: a.kind, start: a.start, end: a.end}) AS stops, count(DISTINCT o) AS orgs
WHERE orgs > 1
RETURN p.name AS researcher, orgs AS organizations_count,
       [i IN range(0, size(stops) - 2) |
         stops[i].org + ' (' + stops[i].kind + ') -> ' + stops[i+1].org + ' (' + stops[i+1].kind + ')'
         + CASE WHEN stops[i+1].start IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ', from ' + toString(stops[i+1].start) END] AS moves
ORDER BY researcher

Question: International reach: Rank researchers by the number of distinct countries represented among their co-authors (excluding their own).
Cypher Query:
MATCH (a:Person) WHERE EXISTS { (a)-[:AUTHORED]->(:Paper) }
OPTIONAL MATCH (a)-[wa:AUTHORED]->(:Paper)<-[wb:AUTHORED]-(b:Person) WHERE b <> a
OPTIONAL MATCH (:Organization {name: wa.affiliation})-[:LOCATED_IN]->(own:Country)
OPTIONAL MATCH (:Organization {name: wb.affiliation})-[:LOCATED_IN]->(other:Country)
WITH a, collect(DISTINCT CASE WHEN other IS NOT NULL AND other <> own THEN other.name END) AS countries
WITH collect({name: a.name, n: size(countries), countries: countries}) AS rows
UNWIND rows AS r
RETURN size([x IN rows WHERE x.n > r.n]) + 1 AS rank, r.name AS researcher,
       r.n AS distinct_foreign_coauthor_countries, r.countries AS countries

Question: Citation influence: Which publications cite the 2022 cathode stability paper, directly or indirectly (transitive citation chain)?

WITH p, path ORDER BY length(path)

       CASE WHEN length(shortest) = 1 THEN 'direct' ELSE 'indirect' END AS citation_type,

Question: Collaboration horizon: Starting from the Halvorsen Institute of Technology, which organizations are reachable within two project-collaboration hops, and through which projects?
Cypher Query:
CALL () {
  MATCH (s:Organization {name: 'Halvorsen Institute of Technology'})-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(p:Project)
        <-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]-(o:Organization)
  WHERE o <> s
  RETURN o, 1 AS hops, s.name + ' -[' + p.name + ']- ' + o.name AS route, [p.name] AS projects
  UNION
  MATCH (s:Organization {name: 'Halvorsen Institute of Technology'})-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(p1:Project)
        <-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]-(m:Organization)-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]->(p2:Project)
        <-[:PARTICIPATES_IN]-(o:Organization)
  WHERE m <> s AND o <> s AND o <> m AND p1 <> p2
  RETURN o, 2 AS hops,
         s.name + ' -[' + p1.name + ']- ' + m.name + ' -[' + p2.name + ']- ' + o.name AS route,
         [p1.name, p2.name] AS projects
}
WITH o, hops, collect(route) AS routes
ORDER BY hops
WITH o, collect({hops: hops, routes: routes}) AS by_distance
RETURN o.name AS organization, by_distance[0].hops AS min_hops, by_distance[0].routes AS routes
ORDER BY min_hops, organization
Answer: [{"organization": "Fjordgrid AS", "min_hops": 1, "routes": ["Halvorsen Institute of Technology -[ALPINE]- Fjordgrid AS"]}, {"organization": "Lumen Storage Systems", "min_hops": 1, "routes": ["Halvorsen Institute of Technology -[ALPINE]- Lumen Storage Systems"]}, {"organization": "Maple Ridge University", "min_hops": 1, "routes": ["Halvorsen Institute of Technology -[CASCADE]- Maple Ridge University"]}, {"organization": "Pacific Cell Technologies", "min_hops": 1, "routes": ["Halvorsen Institute of Technology -[CASCADE]- Pacific Cell Technologies"]}, {"organization": "Rhine Valley University", "min_hops": 1, "routes": ["Halvorsen Institute of Technology -[ALPINE]- Rhine Valley University"]}, {"organization": "Deccan Power Corporation", "min_hops": 2, "routes": ["Halvorsen Institute of Technology -[CASCADE]- Maple Ridge University -[MONSOON]- Deccan Power Corporation"]}, {"organization": "Southern Peninsula Institute of Science", "min_hops": 2, "routes": ["Halvorsen Institute of Technology -[CASCADE]- Maple Ridge University -[MONSOON]- Southern Peninsula Institute of Science"]}]
